title: The best of people
hook: the best of people are those most useful to people (Tabarani)
tomorrow: a new city, his first words to it. what were they?

segments.voice: Yesterday, losing someone: we are Allah's, and to Him we are returning. We return. Today, the hard days close, and a new stretch opens on the day after the funeral.

After a funeral, a house fills with people who don't know what to do with their hands. Someone straightens chairs. Someone says, call me if you need anything, and means it, and nobody ever calls. And then there's the one who shows up on Tuesday with a pot of rice and a roll of trash bags, and quietly takes out the recycling. When news came that his cousin Ja'far had died, the Prophet ﷺ didn't give a speech. He gave an instruction about dinner.
screen: `CALL ME IF YOU NEED ANYTHING.` → `RICE ON TUESDAY.` → `AN INSTRUCTION ABOUT DINNER.`

segments.voice: Make food for Ja'far's family, he said, in Abu Dawud's collection, for something has come upon them that keeps them busy. Not a sermon. Food. That's the door into a new stretch of this path, service, and its first line is a hadith in al-Tabarani's collection: the best of people are those most useful to people. Notice the word people, both times. Not only Muslims, not only family. The Qur'an says it just as wide: "O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct." One human family, measured by how it acts. Now look back at the hard days behind us. He is enough. Cool it with water. People fail; He doesn't. Ask for help. With hardship, ease. We return. On every one of those days, someone useful carried someone in: a driver at two in the morning, a friend with a card, a person with a pot of rice.
screen: `MAKE FOOD FOR JA'FAR'S FAMILY.` · `MOST USEFUL TO PEOPLE.` · `NATIONS AND TRIBES, TO KNOW ONE ANOTHER.` · `THE HARD DAYS, CARRIED IN.` · then, large: `MOST USEFUL.`

segments.voice: Think of one person carrying something heavy right now. Skip the general offer; pick one specific, useful thing: a meal, a ride, a chore, an hour. Decide when you'll do it, and picture yourself at their door.
screen: `ONE PERSON, CARRYING SOMETHING.` · `ONE SPECIFIC, USEFUL THING.` · `WHEN?`

segments.voice: The best of people: those most useful to people. All people, the way the hadith says it.
Your line: most useful. The best of people are often the ones who show up with the rice. Day done.

screen: `DAY 1736 COUNTS.` → `SERVICE AND JUSTICE · 1 OF 10.` → `TOMORROW: A NEW CITY, HIS FIRST WORDS TO IT. WHAT WERE THEY?`

howItsDone: When someone dies, Muslim neighbors and friends bring meals to the bereaved family for several days, following the Prophet's instruction for Ja'far's family; service to anyone in need is counted as worship.

al-Tabarani.meaning: a scholar who compiled large collections of hadith

Abu Dawud.meaning: a scholar who gathered one of the major hadith collections
